completeness.why: All five link functions now only do their own bank lookup and pass their own account row, bank id and event tables to linkBankSyncAccount, which owns upgrade-or-insert (with throw), transfer payee, initial syncAccount, handleSyncResponse and sync-event; the Pluggy file id and Akahu tables are explicit arguments, and the unreachable Enable Banking id check is subsumed.

interface.why: Parameters map to the real variations (account row carrying mask/official_name, eventTables, fileId), but includeFileId is a redundant flag alongside fileId (passing fileId undefined to syncAccount is equivalent), adding a speculative-looking boolean with an array-spread call.

disguised_duplication.where: The five copies of the link sequence are removed and replaced by calls to linkBankSyncAccount; only the per-provider institution/bank lookup remains, which is provider-specific.
